study_type_evidence.quote: 63 tumor-bearing nude mice were randomly divided into 3 groups (n = 21): TP solution, Exo/TP, and cRGD-Exo/TP. The preparations were injected intravenously at drug-equivalent doses of 600 μg/kg TP.
Storage stability and serum stability were assessed by monitoring the particle size of cRGD-Exo/TP in PBS (4 °C, 7 days) or in 10% Exo-free serum (37 °C, 24 h).
A375 and HaCaT cells were purchased from the Chinese Academy of Sciences Cell Bank (Shanghai, China) and cultured in DMEM containing 10% FBS

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: male BALB/c nude, 18–22 g (age not reported)
in_vivo_species.quote: Male BALB/c nude mice (18–22 g) provided by Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center were housed under standard laboratory conditions

ex_vivo_detail: Serum stability assay: particle size of cRGD-Exo/TP monitored in 10% exosome-free serum at 37 °C for 24 h (sampled at 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12 and 24 h; result 155.74 ± 0.62 nm). The body does not state the species or source of this exosome-free serum, so ex_vivo_origin is left as not reported rather than assumed. Excised organs, blood and tumours were also imaged ex vivo by IVIS 24 h after dosing (Fig. 6B).
in_vitro_detail: Human A375 melanoma and HaCaT keratinocyte cell culture: CCK-8 cytotoxicity, Transwell invasion, Annexin V-APC/7-AAD apoptosis, PI cell-cycle, western blotting of apoptosis proteins, PKH67 uptake by CLSM/flow cytometry, endocytosis-inhibitor mechanism studies, and intracellular TP quantification by UHPLC-MS/MS. Also cell-free dialysis drug release in pH 7.4 and pH 5.5 PBS, and PBS storage stability.

concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 6D is a plasma TP concentration versus time curve after a single i.v. dose, sampled at 5, 10, 15, 30 min and 1, 2, 4, 6, 24 h; Table 1 lists the noncompartmental parameters derived from it. Fig. 6C plots DiR fluorescence intensity in tumour tissue against time (IVIS). Fig. 2G plots cumulative in vitro TP release (%) against time over 72 h at pH 7.4 and pH 5.5.

bioanalytical_method: UHPLC-MS/MS (Thermo Fisher Scientific) with ACQUITY UPLC BEH C18 column, positive multiple reaction monitoring, m/z 361.1 → 105.2 for triptolide and m/z 237.1 → 194.0 for carbamazepine internal standard; DiR fluorescence imaging by IVIS at 750/780 nm used for biodistribution only; HPLC used for in vitro drug loading and release
bioanalytical_quote: The positive multiple reaction monitoring (MRM) mode was adopted to determine TP and carbamazepine (internal standard, IS) ... m/z 361.1 → 105.2 for TP and m/z 237.1 → 194.0 for IS
notes: All PK values (t1/2, Cmax, AUC∞, MRT, CL) were taken from Table 1 and the Results body, not the abstract. Table 1 reports no Tmax. The body states parameters were 'fitted by the noncompartment model'. Important caveat: the half-life of 27.14 ± 2.55 h was derived from UHPLC-MS/MS plasma triptolide concentrations (Fig. 6D), not from IVIS imaging; IVIS at 750/780 nm was used only for DiR-labelled biodistribution imaging in a separate n = 3 cohort. The half-life therefore describes the triptolide payload of the cRGD-Exo/TP formulation rather than the cRGD peptide itself. Statistics are reported as mean ± SD. hUCMSCs were derived from human umbilical cords of healthy newborns with written informed consent, but no human subject was dosed, so no clinical arm is recorded. The species/source of the 'Exo-free serum' used in the serum-stability assay is not stated in the body.
